summary: Verified (1) property search now matches colony and (2) PHED auto-link (suggestions + apply) end-to-end. Backend pytest 4/4 pass in ~16s: GET /api/admin/properties?search=Didar returns total=1024 with colony 'Didar Nagar' rows; owner_name/property_id/mobile searches still work; GET /api/phed/link-suggestions?limit=500 returns total_unlinked=26407, properties_available=1024, 500 suggestions each with consumer_ref/property_record_id/confidence(high|medium)/reason('phone match'|'address & name'), high-first sort verified; POST /api/phed/link-suggestions/apply with 2 items returned {linked>=1} and GET /api/phed/consumers?linked=yes shows those consumers with linked_property populated. Frontend UI: Admin login -> select THS -> /admin/properties: typing 'Didar' in search input filters to 20 Didar Nagar rows. /admin/phed/consumers: [data-testid=bulk-link-btn] opens [data-testid=bulk-link-dialog]; after ~15s dialog populated with 600 suggestion rows (300 pre-checked, 'high phone match' badges), [data-testid=apply-bulk-link-btn] present. Header updated to '26405 unlinked' confirming persistence of prior applied links.
critical_code_review_comments: link_suggestions endpoint scans ~26k consumers each call (~15s) - consider caching or a background job/pre-computed index for large-scale runs.
Suggestions API returns 600 items when limit=500 requested (see UI screenshot header '300 suggested matches' but list has 600) - verify server-side cap; not blocking but worth aligning.
seed_data_creation: None. Applied 2 real link mappings from suggestions during apply test (reversible via unlink).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-link endpoint is slow (~15-20s, scans all unlinked); use timeout>=60. Suggestions response keys: total_unlinked, properties_available, suggestions[]. Apply body: {links:[{consumer_ref, property_record_id}]}. UI testids: bulk-link-btn, bulk-link-dialog, suggestion-<ref>, suggestion-check-<ref>, apply-bulk-link-btn. Property search 'search' param now covers colony/address/owner_name/property_id/mobile.
rca of the issue: Prior iteration flagged that /api/admin/properties?search=<colony> returned 0; server $or now includes colony+address so 'Didar' returns full 1024 dataset. Auto-link feature works end-to-end with expected confidence/reason metadata and persistence.
